reviewer: Codex AI: informed semantic and source-alignment review
review_scope: All24 semantic annotations in the existing178-record packet; the original packet remains unchanged.

status_reasons.explicit_fact: Unqualified narration within the supplied fiction; not a real-world historical assertion.
status_reasons.character_statement: Spoken or written claim/preference, without treating the utterance as independent corroboration.
status_reasons.plan: Announced appointment, promise or schedule, not evidence of completion.
status_reasons.request: A direction or request, not an accomplished event.
status_reasons.hypothetical: An imagined response or counterfactual wish; quotation marks alone do not make it actual speech.
status_reasons.uncertain_or_inferred: The source explicitly qualifies an interpretation, prediction or uncertainty.
status_reasons.reported_information: What a narrator or character says they heard; this does not verify the reported event.
status_reasons.not_established: The supplied excerpt lacks the requested identity, location, remarriage detail or payment amount. Wider-book memory is not evidence.

clarify.action: Replace only the classification quotation with the explicit offer to help later in the same supplied passage; retain plan label and original source body.
clarify.reason: The earlier reassurance can be read as a prediction. An explicit offer is a clearer promise example.

limitations: No source prose generated or rewritten.
This review does not authorise model promotion.
